description: DESTRUCTIVE: Permanently delete session data matching the given filters. Disabled by default; the machine owner must explicitly enable destructive MCP tools. Always creates a tar.gz backup before deleting (restorable with tokmeter_restore). Requires at least one filter — a project, providers, or a date range (since/until or a today/week/month scope); an empty filter is refused because it would delete every session. ALWAYS call tokmeter_cleanup_preview first and pass its one-time receipt with the same filters. Requires confirm='DELETE' as an additional safety guard.

backup.description: Accepted for compatibility only: over MCP a tar.gz backup is always created before deleting, even when false

confirm.description: Must be exactly 'DELETE' to proceed with deletion

preview_id.description: One-time receipt returned by tokmeter_cleanup_preview for these exact filters

scope.description: Time scope: today, week (last 7d), month (calendar month), or all (default)

since.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for custom date range

until.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) for custom date range

name: tokmeter_cleanup_execute
